description: Source code for a Linux kernel driver implementing button hotplug functionality for OpenWrt, handling input events, creating uevents, and broadcasting them via netlink.

methods.name: button_hotplug_create_event
methods.description: Creates and schedules a button event (pressed/released) with associated data.

methods.name: button_hotplug_event
methods.description: Handles input events, filters for key events, and triggers button event creation.

methods.name: button_hotplug_connect
methods.description: Handles connection of input devices, registers handle, and initializes private data.

methods.name: button_hotplug_disconnect
methods.description: Handles disconnection of input devices, unregisters handle, and frees private data.

methods.name: button_get_index
methods.description: Returns index of button code in button_map array.

methods.name: button_hotplug_fill_event
methods.description: Fills event data with environment variables for uevent.

methods.name: button_hotplug_work
methods.description: Performs work to send uevent via netlink.

methods.name: button_event_add_var
methods.description: Adds a variable string to the skb buffer for uevent.
